definition.name: Sealed normal Java compiler product (data only)

steps.name: Install the maintained recipe reader dependencies
Select the runner-owned compiler archive cache
Restore untrusted source-pinned Java prepared inputs
Verify fixed compiler inputs, existing pack and installer, and normal admission
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/latent-java-product.XXXXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$root"' EXIT
mkdir -p target/java-compiler-product
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5 1195 \
  python -B tools/java_guest/compiler_profile_distribution.py stage \
    --root "$root" \
    --output target/java-compiler-product/result.json

steps.name: Save only reverified Java prepared input bytes
Recover the fixed retained compiler product as data only
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/latent-java-custody.XXXXXXXX)
trap 'timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=1 5 rm -rf -- "$root"' EXIT
mkdir -p target
timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5 1195 \
  python -B tools/java_guest/compiler_profile_distribution.py recover-custody \
    --root "$root" \
    --output "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/java-compiler-custody"

reviewReason: Add a fixed retained-product recovery branch, complete measured pair and original manifest retention; keep the old product route and historical obligations.
